purpose: Verified additions/clarifications for incorporation into the canonical ongoing source registry; discovery alone is not ingestion.

sources.provider: NERRS / Weeks Bay Reserve via NOAA NDBC and CDMO
sources.station_name: Fish River, Weeks Bay Reserve, AL
sources.freshness_basis: NDBC station page showed same-day 15-minute observations
sources.quality_basis: NERRS SWMP data use automated primary QA/QC plus reserve/CDMO secondary and tertiary QA/QC; historical data are distributed through CDMO
sources.production_role: high-frequency Weeks Bay/Fish River direct observation; PROXY for Eastern Shore open-bay bottom state, never local Montrose/Point Clear bottom DO

sources.provider: NERRS / Weeks Bay Reserve via NOAA NDBC
sources.station_name: Safe Harbor Met Station, Weeks Bay Reserve, AL
sources.production_role: local Weeks Bay meteorology/context; not a direct Eastern Shore shoreline wind measurement

sources.historical_access: NCEI THREDDS NGOFS2 archive includes 2021-2026 model directories as of verification

regular_grid_schema_verified.temperature: time x Depth x ny x nx
regular_grid_schema_verified.salinity: time x Depth x ny x nx

sources.production_role: shoreward-transport/current and vertical salinity/temperature guidance after cell-specific spatial extraction and held-out validation

guardrails: WKQA1 is direct for its own station, but remains a proxy for open-bay Montrose/Fairhope/Point Clear bottom conditions.
NGOFS2 is MODEL guidance and must never be labeled an observation.
Do not promote a shoreline-current predictor until cell geometry, vector projection and out-of-sample incremental value are validated.
